items.body: `make model-validate` silently skips the new standalone stage. Its actual route is `model-time` → `model-check` → framework `gate`, with `UMPIRE_BACKENDS=require`. However, `self.required` is initialized only from `command == "validate"`, so this condition skips standalone even during the root validation command. A broken isolated framework can consequently escape the authoritative gate.
items.suggestion: Make standalone selection recognize the validation mode used by the root caller, while preserving the child recursion exclusion. Cover that actual invocation path in the wiring controls.

## Issue 2
- **Severity**: P1
- **Title**: `make model-validate` silently skips the new standalone stage
- **Confidence**: 100
- **Classification**: introduced
- **Problem**: `make model-validate` silently skips the new standalone stage. Its actual route is `model-time` → `model-check` → framework `gate`, with `UMPIRE_BACKENDS=require`. However, `self.required` is initialized only from `command == "validate"`, so this condition skips standalone even during the root validation command. A broken isolated framework can consequently escape the authoritative gate.
- **Suggestion**: Make standalone selection recognize the validation mode used by the root caller, while preserving the child recursion exclusion. Cover that actual invocation path in the wiring controls.
